exact_consumers.name: life-layer migration / factual RenderSituation
authorized_use: consume PRESENTATION_ONLY current-situation statements for the caller/application portion of ephemeral RenderSituation
preserve distinction from separately authoritative V3 current generated state
forbidden_use: create biography or LifeContainer/LifeSeason authority from caller/application context
default or randomize missing current situation
convert caller statement into generated actor fact

exact_consumers.name: typed noncausal SessionState
authorized_use: persist statement records, provenance, subject binding, effective-time scope, contradiction sets and unknown state as noncausal session state
forbidden_use: promote persisted session context into V3 memory/history, relationship state or objective actor truth

exact_consumers.name: stable application envelope / terminal hostile harness
authorized_use: expose authorized presentation/session fields and epistemic state
enforce no-inference, contradiction, expiry, unknown and no-causal-promotion invariants
forbidden_use: treat application metadata as causal history

interaction.request_received_at.meaning: application-observed receipt time for the current request/turn

interaction.channel.meaning: actual application/channel surface used for this interaction

interaction.mode_context.meaning: declared session interaction premise/mode metadata that is not itself V3 truth

situation.current_time.meaning: asserted/observed current clock/calendar fact for the bound subject or environment

situation.current_location.meaning: asserted/observed current physical location at stated granularity

situation.current_device.meaning: current client/device/interface fact or explicitly asserted in-world device fact

situation.current_privacy.meaning: current privacy/audibility/visibility condition within the source observation jurisdiction

situation.current_interruption.meaning: interruption occurring now or current interruption constraint/risk explicitly asserted or directly observed

situation.current_activity.meaning: activity the bound subject is explicitly asserted/observed to be doing now

situation.current_availability_constrain.meaning: immediate caller/session communication constraint such as time available, need for brevity, or modality limitation

situation.interaction_reason.meaning: caller-declared reason/purpose for being in the current interaction

presentation.client_context.meaning: bounded UI/form-factor/accessibility/routing context needed only to render or route the current session

explicitly_non_authorized_legacy_or_sess: client_ip as identity, precise location, demographic identity, belief, or generated-actor property
demographics as current situation or generated actor truth by persistence alone
answer1/answer2/questionnaire text as current objective fact without an authorized statement envelope
country_resolution as identity/belief/class/sect/ethnicity/current physical location without a separate lawful current-location statement
conversation_history/transcript summaries/topic streams/EnergeticField/chat diagnostics as actor memory/relationship history/personality/motive/causal biography
legacy TodayState fields created from defaults or randomness
persona-sheet/generated biography fields as caller-current-situation authority

rules: GENERATED_ACTOR requires exact generated actor_id; display name is insufficient
CALLER may use ephemeral session-scoped caller ID; IP/session/device/location does not silently become identity
CALLER_ASSERTED about GENERATED_ACTOR identifies proposition target but does not create actor truth
no CALLER/APPLICATION value may be rebound to GENERATED_ACTOR by analogy, co-location, shared device, geography or session association

CALLER_ASSERTED.authority: authoritative that caller asserted the exact proposition with recorded provenance

APPLICATION_OBSERVED.authority: direct observation only within concrete application measurement jurisdiction

APPLICATION_DERIVED_PRESENTATION_ONLY.authority: deterministic presentation derivation from authorized application observations

effective_time.persistence_rule: point/current assertion with no source-authorized continuation is current for the containing request/turn only
effective_time.open_interval_rule: allowed only when source explicitly asserts/observes ongoing validity

confidence_law.source_supplied_confidence_or_measuremen: preserve as source metadata without universal probability conversion

may_affect: rendering/session behavior only where an accepted V2 rule explicitly names the field

requirements: observable external condition/event rather than inferred motive/belief/identity/personality/memory/relationship truth
explicit caller/application intent to enter in-world causal path

triggers: consumer request outside source observation jurisdiction

trust_authority_precedence: V3 generated/admitted truth is sovereign for generated actor causal facts/history
V3 admission receipt is sovereign for whether a causal event occurred
application direct observation owns only application/session properties it directly measures
caller assertion owns the fact and source-declared semantics of the assertion, not objective actor truth
session record owns session lifecycle/state only
application derivation may only narrow/transform presentation semantics and never increase authority
nonactual scenario context never competes with actual-world truth

v3_admission_relationship.causal_candidate_path: PROPOSED_CAUSAL_INPUT -> separately governed V2->V3 package -> V3 admission/rejection
v3_admission_relationship.admitted_authority_source: V3 admitted external event and receipt, not this caller statement record

forbidden_inferences: IP -> personal identity/precise physical location/generated-actor location/belief
session demographics/questionnaire -> current objective actor facts without a new authorized statement envelope
transcript/summary/topic stream/EnergeticField -> causal memory/relationship state/belief/motive/personality/current objective fact
caller assertion about generated actor -> generated actor fact without V3 admission/generation
server/request time -> actor event time without explicit binding
caller current context -> V550+ structural prior/producer evidence
caller current context -> retroactive V3 history rewrite
confidence/knowledge state -> invented numeric probability/global trust score
compatibility_constraints: recovered session dictionaries/tables may carry statement envelopes but legacy keys do not become facts by existence
conversation_history remains session/transcript material under its separate retention authority
EnergeticField remains presentation/session state under its separate rule authority
legacy TodayState generation is incompatible when used as actual current context
deterministic nonactual scenario generation is compatible only as SCENARIO_DECLARED_NONACTUAL and PRESENTATION_ONLY
current-context APIs must require field-level provenance/effective time/subject binding instead of untyped context blobs
cached current views must retain source statement IDs and expiry/conflict state
historical V5/DDM semantics are not promoted

archive.authority_limit: Recovered V3/V2/server is continuity/authority-recovery evidence only; historical V5/DDM has zero authority over current V550+.

hostile_fixtures.attack: caller says actor is at cafe
summary says user busy -> current fact
pending current-situation candidate -> actor event before admission
rejected V3 candidate used later as actor history
random hypothetical cafe scenario -> actual location
later assertion silently overwrites earlier conflict
current residence claim -> past history rewrite
